name: Modular Monolith Architecture
catalog_source: Richards & Ford (2020); Bass et al. (2021); Millett & Tune (2015)
forces_resolved: High domain modularity without network overhead
Single deployment unit with strict internal package boundaries
Strong immediate ACID transaction consistency across modules
Low operational complexity and low infrastructure costs
forces_unresolved: Runtime failure blast radius (unhandled crash affects entire process)
Requires code-level discipline to prevent cross-module boundary leakage
applicability_conditions: Startups and enterprises wanting clean domain boundaries without distributed complexity
Strict requirement for immediate ACID database transactions
anti_requisites: Independent autonomous team release cadences with separate CI/CD pipelines
Polyglot technology stack requirements across business capabilities
Target throughput exceeding 50,000 req/sec requiring heterogeneous scaling
